messages:
Jordan P: kicking off prod push for v2.4.0. planned canary: 1% for 15m, then 5% -> 20% if green. ff:multi-route=true will be enabled. change window til 03:00 UTC.
Deploy-Bot: deploy queued - id: deploy-1738891000. will run canary, metrics gating enabled.
Lena M: heads up — new reranker quantization in this build. watch 99th p90 token latency and model mismatch logs.
Priya S: telemetry alerts added. thresholds: 5xx >0.2% or latency +25% over baseline triggers hold.
Deploy-Bot: canary started at 1%. ff:multi-route=true applied to cohorts: free=on, premium=off, internal=on.
ops-bot: canary (5m) update: 5xx 0.05% baseline 0.03%, latency +4%. no gating.
Lena M: seeing a rise in rerank tail for premium-adjacent requests despite premium pinned. investigating routing spillover.
Jordan P: ok—emergency plan: set ff:multi-route=false for region=eu and cohort=premium to eliminate spillover. keep free cohort on to preserve client experience.
Priya S: applying toggle: `POST /flags/multi-route?cohort=premium&region=eu&state=off` -> 202 Accepted
Deploy-Bot: flag update acknowledged. continuing rollout for other cohorts.
ops-bot: canary (15m) update: tail latency normalized, 5xx down to 0.02%. good.
QA Bot: ran smoke tests on premium sample in eu — responses stable.
Lena M: collected logs: `ERROR rerank: quant-dequant-mismatch model=v2.4.0 node=rr-7` - not triggering user errors but spiking log noise.
Jordan P: decision: keep canary progressing to 5% for 20m, keep premium eu pinned off for now. create tracking note in release notes.
Priya S: added to release notes: "v2.4.0 canary progressing; premium (eu) temporarily pinned due to reranker quant logs; monitoring continues". link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2077
Lena M: will open a follow-up ticket for quant compatibility tests and reranker preflight.
Jordan P: Deploy-Bot — schedule rollback safety: if critical 5xx >0.5% in next 30m rollback to v2.3.x.
Deploy-Bot: rollback policy set: auto-rollback threshold = 0.5% 5xx over 10m. rollback window 30m. To abort auto-rollback run: `deploy abort-rollback deploy-1738891000`.
Priya S: tagging oncall: @eng-oncall @Lena M @Jordan P
ops-bot: mid-rollout update: ramp to 5% applied at 03:10 UTC. metrics: 5xx 0.03%, latency +2%.
QA Bot: internal smoke passed, no regression on canonical prompts.
Jordan P: leaving this thread as canonical. if anything degrades we rollback. else plan after change window: unpin premium eu with staged ramp 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 2 hours.
Lena M: noted. I'll attach logs and a patch candidate for the quant path by EOD.
Priya S: final check: remind support to update release notes public summary: short blurb about staged rollout and premium eu temporary pin.
Deploy-Bot: deploy-1738891000 status: ROLLING (1%->5% complete). will post final status post-window.
